title: Architecture Model
description: A persisted, workspace-wide map of module boundaries, canonical abstractions, and architectural invariants. One per workspace, updated in place rather than versioned by id. Built and maintained by scribe:arch-auditor in build/refresh mode; checked against by scribe:arch-auditor in check mode before a spec enters planning.

path.description: Workspace-relative path to the module, package, or crate root

responsibility.description: One paragraph: what this module owns and why it exists as a separate boundary

depends_on.description: Names of other modules this one is allowed to depend on. A dependency running the other direction is a boundary violation.

modules.description: The boundary map — every module the model tracks, its responsibility, and its allowed dependency direction.

concept.description: The domain concept this abstraction represents (e.g. 'user identity', 'retry policy')

type_or_interface.description: The canonical type, trait, or interface name

location.description: File path where the canonical definition lives

rationale.description: Why this is the one representation new code should reuse rather than reinvent

canonical_abstractions.description: The registry of 'this is the one true representation of X' — a new spec introducing a competing type for an already-modeled concept is a finding, not a fresh design choice.

rule.description: The rigid architectural property that must hold

enforced_by.description: The test, type check, or lint that fails if this invariant is violated, if one exists

invariants.description: System-wide invariants — cumulative across every structural fix scribe:architect has ever produced, plus any the build pass surfaced directly.

last_built_from.description: Commit hash or other repository state marker the model was last built or refreshed against. Absence means staleness cannot be assessed — treat as a coverage gap, not proof the model is current.
